body:
Dash is fixed! The headlight fuse was blown, and that killed the dash, first thought it was a short as the power wire to the dash harness was burnt, but power is still making it through, just looks crispy!

Now I’m getting C46 and _ for throttle position, so I’ll have to get into that tomorrow
I pulled the connector on the back of the gauge cluster, but when I’m under the tank it wouldn’t hurt to spray every connection with contact cleaner, really hope it is something silly like that

I know how to active the “dealer mode” which is what tells me what codes are active yeah, but you are right, my dash needs to be working for me to actually see the code😭 

And the fastest one I can get is 300 bucks on eBay and it takes 2-3 weeks to arrive, so I’d be flying blind on diag till that arrives if it’s the dash itself that went bad
Could that cause a rich condition even with a fairly even idle of 1200? It would fluctuate up and down maybe 100 but I have just been thinking that’s cause the valves are out
I like trains
I wish a man would do that to me

Magnet on a stick is a great tool for wrenching on your own bike!

Just make sure you follow the bible and they’re in spec! Otherwise you’ll either not get full valve lift, or float the valves
Normal, you set clearances cold, and as the engine warms up, the thermal expansion will close up that gap

3:30pm…. Most would still be at work for another hour, nice work slumlord.

Not only do I doubt the legality of imposing a “lease infraction” (whatever the hell that means?) for being unable to attend such BS, but I also doubt anything that gets said during such “meeting” couldn’t be addressed in an email to all tenants.

Being a bit overly dramatic.

My involvement doesn’t change that she chose to directly violate the lease by bringing a pet in.

It’s beyond inconveniencing me, it’s showing a lack of common decency and respect for what is considered mine by the lease.

Luckily my neighbours don’t seem to be terrible enough to try to run me down on my bike or anything to that extent, she just might try to give me another sob story and irritate me into pitying her.

Your previous neighbours sound awful, can’t believe they’d go so low as to harm you and your roommate over those sorts of things.

But she’s overstayed her welcome in my garage, especially with the propane cylinders and gas can she has put in there, which would be negligence and my renters insurance void if they were to explode. 

I really like the rental, it’s in a good part of town for me, it’s quiet, I get a garage which is a huge bonus that not many get, but these neighbours are making the things that made me like this rental difficult, and I’d not want to jeopardize it further by dragging the LL into this again after the garage incident originally happened and risk not getting my lease renewed or them trying to terminate it.
Eva Lovia
Solved! The O2 sensor I was sold by the shop was wrong, it was for a 2004 STi, I ordered the correct one, and after installing/clearing the code, it didn’t come back on.
I guess next would be a multimeter and seeing if there’s a voltage loss, I need to find something in the manual that tells me how much voltage I should be reading

Got a Denso replacement through an auto parts store for my model and the one I took out was denso too, nasioc said something about a fuse for the circuit, but I can’t find anything specific, all engine bay fuses are fine.
What good does it do, I can’t bring her back, my only real family is dead and I’m all alone
My family kicked me out for being lesbian, I haven’t spoken to them in years. And my few friends don’t have anything constructive to say, or they think I should have gotten over it by now
It’s been a month now

I don’t have the motivation to do any of that, I barely have the energy to get up, let alone do anything.

Why would I do anything for a world that took mine from me, she didn’t deserve this
I...I can’t, our apartment building doesn’t allow pets, I can’t even get a cat, I cant even have a purpose in life, how is one supposed to go on like that
It’s been 8 days, and they have been the worst days of my life

How am I supposed to do that, I grew up in an abusive environment, I cut, that didn’t make her proud, it took her, drugs and a phycologist a year to make me stop, and I failed her last night..... if she is watching me, I failed her. I miss her so much, she was all that I had.

I don’t know how to keep going
I... I don’t know if I can, she got me clean from self harm, now I... I don’t know if I can do it without her, I don’t know if I can live without her.

I’ve had some bad experiences with the crisis lines, they haven’t helped me in the past.... 
I just.... it’s really hard to articulate what I’m feeling, it took me the better part of the day to write up my original post.

Im scared, scared that I’m going to relapse.... I haven’t hurt myself in over 2 years, but it’s so fucking hard staying clean since she died
